senses.en: A fresh assessment of something, often leading to changed views.

ex.en: The unexpected repair bill prompted a reappraisal of our budget.
ex.zh: 意外的维修账单促使我们重新审视预算。

ex.en: New evidence has led to a reappraisal of the environmental benefits associated with this farming method.
ex.zh: 新的证据促使人们重新评价这种耕作方式带来的环境效益。

col: a thorough reappraisal｜全面重新评估
prompt a reappraisal｜促使重新评价
a reappraisal of priorities｜对优先事项的重新审视
tip: 常用a reappraisal of，表示对某事重新评价。

senses.en: A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.

ex.en: A small toad was hiding beneath the garden pot.
ex.zh: 一只小蟾蜍躲在花园的花盆下面。

ex.en: Protecting ponds and nearby woodland helps toads survive as urban development reduces their natural habitats.
ex.zh: 城市开发使蟾蜍的自然栖息地缩小，保护池塘及附近林地有助于它们生存。

tip: toad指蟾蜍；frog通常指青蛙。

senses.en: to cause someone or something to suffer harm

ex.en: The storm inflicted serious damage on our garden fence.
ex.zh: 暴风雨严重损坏了我们花园的围栏。

ex.en: Unregulated industrial activity can inflict lasting damage on ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of nearby communities.
ex.zh: 不受监管的工业活动可能对生态系统造成持久破坏，并威胁附近社区居民的生计。

tip: 搭配为inflict伤害on对象，不能说inflict sb。

senses.en: the top layer of branches and leaves in a forest
a cover over something

ex.en: Sunlight filtered through the forest canopy.
ex.zh: 阳光透过树冠层洒下来。

ex.en: Many rainforest animals spend their entire lives in the canopy and never touch the forest floor.
ex.zh: 许多雨林动物一生都生活在树冠层，从不下到林地。

tip: 雨林分层：emergent、canopy、understory、forest floor。

senses.en: An exact copy of something
To make an exact copy or repeat something unnecessarily
Exactly matching another item

ex.en: I keep a duplicate of the key at home.
ex.zh: 我在家里留了一把备用钥匙。

ex.en: Research teams should share their findings to avoid duplicating work and wasting limited public funding.
ex.zh: 研究团队应共享研究成果，以免重复劳动并浪费有限的公共资金。

tip: 名词、形容词结尾读/kət/；动词读/keɪt/。

senses.en: a system of methods and principles used in research

ex.en: Our tutor explained the methodology before we began our project.
ex.zh: 开始项目之前，导师向我们讲解了研究方法。

ex.en: Researchers must describe their methodology clearly so that others can evaluate the reliability of their findings.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须清楚描述其研究方法，以便他人评估研究结果的可靠性。

col: develop a methodology｜制定方法体系
tip: method是具体方法；methodology侧重整套方法及原理。

senses.en: A person employed to do practical work on a farm

ex.en: A farmhand carried fresh hay into the barn this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一名农场雇工把新鲜干草搬进了谷仓。

ex.en: Seasonal farmhands play an important role in harvesting crops where agricultural machinery cannot easily be used.
ex.zh: 在难以使用农业机械的地方，季节性农场雇工在收割作物方面发挥着重要作用。

col: work as a farmhand｜当农场雇工
hire a farmhand｜雇用农场工人
tip: hand可指干体力活的人；farmhand是雇工而非农场主。

senses.en: Matter made of particles with charges opposite to ordinary matter.

ex.en: Why the universe has so little antimatter is a mystery.
ex.zh: 宇宙中反物质为何这么少仍是个谜。

senses.en: a collection of work showing someone's skills and experience
a collection of investments owned by a person or organization
a minister's position or area of government responsibility

ex.en: She brought her photography portfolio to the interview.
ex.zh: 她带着自己的摄影作品集去参加面试。

ex.en: A diversified investment portfolio can reduce financial risk, although it cannot guarantee steady returns.
ex.zh: 多元化的投资组合可以降低金融风险，但不能保证稳定的回报。

col: a portfolio of work｜一套作品集
hold a portfolio｜担任部长职务
tip: 求职时常指作品集；金融语境指投资组合。

senses.en: to give someone information that helps them understand something

ex.en: Could you enlighten me about how this camera works?
ex.zh: 你能给我讲讲这台相机怎么用吗？

ex.en: Public health campaigns should enlighten citizens about the benefits of vaccination while addressing common concerns respectfully.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应让公众了解接种疫苗的益处，同时以尊重的态度回应常见顾虑。

col: an enlightening discussion｜有启发性的讨论
tip: 常用enlighten sb about/on sth，语气较正式。

senses.en: a tiny opening in skin or another surface
to read or examine something with great attention

ex.en: Tiny drops of sweat appeared around his skin pores.
ex.zh: 他的皮肤毛孔周围冒出了细小的汗珠。

ex.en: Researchers pore over historical records to understand how earlier societies responded to periods of severe drought.
ex.zh: 研究人员仔细研读历史记录，以了解过去的社会如何应对严重干旱时期。

col: pore over documents｜仔细研读文件
tip: 动词常用pore over，勿与pour over混淆。

senses.en: the dead body of an animal

ex.en: Vultures circled above the carcass.
ex.zh: 秃鹫在尸体上空盘旋。

ex.en: A whale carcass on the seafloor can feed a community of deep-sea creatures for decades.
ex.zh: 海底的一具鲸尸可以养活一群深海生物长达数十年。

tip: 指动物尸体；人类遗体用 corpse 或 body。

senses.en: The size, extent, or importance of something.
A measure of the energy released by an earthquake.

ex.en: We only realised the magnitude of the damage at sunrise.
ex.zh: 直到日出时，我们才意识到损坏的严重程度。

ex.en: The magnitude of global food waste highlights the need for better storage systems and more responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 全球食物浪费的巨大规模凸显了改善储存系统和更负责任地消费的必要性。

col: the magnitude of the problem｜问题的严重程度
an earthquake of magnitude six｜六级地震
an order of magnitude｜一个数量级
tip: 谈规模常用the magnitude of；震级也用此词。

senses.en: A situation that is strikingly opposite to what is expected.
Using words opposite to your meaning, often for humorous effect.

ex.en: The irony is that our swimming lesson was cancelled by rain.
ex.zh: 讽刺的是，我们的游泳课竟因下雨而取消了。

ex.en: There is considerable irony in promoting environmental awareness through disposable products that create additional waste.
ex.zh: 通过制造更多垃圾的一次性产品来宣传环保意识，颇具讽刺意味。

col: the irony of the situation｜局面的讽刺之处
a sense of irony｜反讽意识
tip: irony不只是巧合，常指结果与预期形成讽刺性反差。

senses.en: The arrival of an important new invention, event, or period

ex.en: The advent of smartphones changed how we take photos.
ex.zh: 智能手机的出现改变了我们拍照的方式。

ex.en: The advent of affordable renewable energy has encouraged governments to reconsider their dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的可再生能源的出现，促使各国政府重新审视对化石燃料的依赖。

col: with the advent of｜随着……的到来
since the advent of｜自……出现以来
tip: 常用the advent of，指重要新事物的出现。

senses.en: To help opposing sides reach an agreement.

ex.en: Our neighbour offered to mediate when we argued about parking.
ex.zh: 我们因停车问题争吵时，邻居主动提出调解。

ex.en: Independent organisations can mediate between employers and workers to resolve disputes before they disrupt essential public services.
ex.zh: 独立机构可以在雇主与员工之间进行调解，在纠纷影响基本公共服务之前将其解决。

col: mediate between two sides｜在双方之间调解
mediate a settlement｜调解达成和解
tip: mediate侧重促成协议；arbitrate可指作出仲裁。

senses.en: Distance north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.
Freedom to choose how to act or decide.

ex.en: Our geography teacher showed us latitude on a globe.
ex.zh: 地理老师用地球仪给我们讲解纬度。

ex.en: Regions at higher latitudes generally experience greater seasonal variations in daylight than those near the equator.
ex.zh: 高纬度地区的日照时长通常比赤道附近地区有更明显的季节变化。

col: give someone latitude｜给予某人自主权
tip: latitude是纬度，longitude是经度。

senses.en: Hidden by a shadow or outshone by something else.

ex.en: The eclipsed moon turned a deep copper red.
ex.zh: 被遮蔽的月亮变成了深铜红色。

senses.en: continuing strongly without stopping or becoming less intense
showing no sympathy or willingness to become less harsh

ex.en: The relentless rain kept us indoors all weekend.
ex.zh: 雨下个不停，我们整个周末都待在屋里。

ex.en: Relentless pressure to achieve high grades can undermine students' confidence and damage their mental health.
ex.zh: 持续不断的高分压力会削弱学生的信心，并损害他们的心理健康。

tip: 不限于“无情的”，也常形容雨、压力等持续不减。

senses.en: To tend towards a particular opinion or course of action
To lean or move something towards a sloping position
A surface that slopes upwards or downwards

ex.en: I incline towards the cheaper option for our holiday.
ex.zh: 对于我们的假期，我倾向于选择更便宜的方案。

ex.en: Rising housing costs may incline young adults to remain in their parents' homes longer.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本可能使年轻人更倾向于延长与父母同住的时间。

col: incline towards a view｜倾向于某种观点
be inclined to agree｜倾向于赞同
tip: 动词重音在后；名词读/ˈɪnklaɪn/。

senses.en: a fixed social class; a specialized group in an insect colony

ex.en: The society had a strict caste system.
ex.zh: 那个社会有严格的种姓制度。

ex.en: In a termite colony, each caste, from workers to soldiers, performs a different role and looks physically different.
ex.zh: 在白蚁群落中，从工蚁到兵蚁，每个等级分工不同，外形也不同。

tip: 社会性昆虫讲座中也用 caste 指“品级”。

senses.en: Similar in a way that allows a useful comparison.

ex.en: Our shared kitchen is analogous to a busy workshop.
ex.zh: 我们的共用厨房就像一个忙碌的工坊。

ex.en: The role of public libraries is analogous to that of schools in supporting lifelong learning within communities.
ex.zh: 在支持社区终身学习方面，公共图书馆的作用与学校类似。

tip: 常用be analogous to，强调某方面可作比较。

senses.en: To make something widely known, liked, or used.
To explain specialist knowledge so ordinary people can understand it.

ex.en: Her cooking videos helped popularize this simple bean soup.
ex.zh: 她的烹饪视频让这道简单的豆汤流行起来。

ex.en: Public broadcasters can popularize scientific knowledge by explaining complex discoveries through accessible documentaries and practical demonstrations.
ex.zh: 公共广播机构可以通过通俗的纪录片和实际演示解释复杂的发现，从而普及科学知识。

col: popularize an idea｜推广一种观念
tip: 英式也常写popularise；不只是“宣传”。

senses.en: to show or describe something in art, images, or words

ex.en: This painting depicts children playing beside a quiet lake.
ex.zh: 这幅画描绘了孩子们在宁静的湖边玩耍的情景。

ex.en: Films often depict urban life as exciting, overlooking the isolation that many residents experience in large cities.
ex.zh: 电影常将城市生活描绘得令人兴奋，却忽略了许多大城市居民感受到的孤独。

col: depict daily life｜描绘日常生活
depict someone as｜将某人描绘成
tip: depict A as B：把A描绘成B。

senses.en: Land covered with grass where farm animals feed.
To put animals on grassland so they can feed.

ex.en: The cows wandered across the green pasture after sunrise.
ex.zh: 日出后，牛群在绿色的牧草地上漫步。

ex.en: Converting forests into pasture can reduce biodiversity and increase greenhouse gas emissions from land use.
ex.zh: 将森林改为牧场可能减少生物多样性，并增加土地利用产生的温室气体排放。

col: put cattle out to pasture｜把牛赶到牧场放牧
tip: pasture强调供牲畜吃草的土地，不是普通草坪。

senses.en: Someone who writes an account of another person's life.

ex.en: The biographer interviewed my grandmother about her childhood friend.
ex.zh: 那位传记作者采访了我祖母，了解她童年好友的往事。

ex.en: A responsible biographer compares multiple sources before drawing conclusions about a historical figure's personal motivations.
ex.zh: 负责任的传记作者会先比较多种资料，再对历史人物的个人动机作出判断。

col: an official biographer｜官方传记作者
a royal biographer｜王室传记作者
a renowned biographer｜著名传记作者
tip: biographer写他人传记；自传是autobiography。

senses.en: Caused by a virus; spreading quickly online.

ex.en: Antibiotics do not work against viral infections.
ex.zh: 抗生素对病毒感染无效。

senses.en: a confident statement that something is true
the act of firmly expressing rights, authority, or independence

ex.en: Her assertion that the shop was closed proved wrong.
ex.zh: 她断言商店已经关门，结果证明她错了。

ex.en: The assertion that economic growth always improves wellbeing requires careful examination of social and environmental evidence.
ex.zh: 经济增长总能改善福祉这一断言，需要通过仔细审视社会和环境证据来检验。

col: challenge an assertion｜质疑某项断言
tip: 常用the assertion that…；断言不代表已有证据。

senses.en: an empty space inside something
a hole in a tooth

ex.en: The dentist found a small cavity.
ex.zh: 牙医发现了一个小龋洞。

ex.en: Woodpeckers carve nesting cavities in dead trees, which other birds later reuse.
ex.zh: 啄木鸟在枯树上凿出巢洞，之后其他鸟类也会使用。

tip: 解剖学：chest cavity 胸腔。

senses.en: A state in which all movement or activity has stopped.

ex.en: Traffic came to a standstill outside the station.
ex.zh: 车站外的交通完全停滞了。

ex.en: Severe flooding brought construction to a standstill, delaying urgently needed housing projects across the region.
ex.zh: 严重洪灾使施工完全停顿，延误了该地区急需的住房项目。

col: come to a standstill｜陷入停顿
bring something to a standstill｜使某事停顿
at a standstill｜处于停滞状态
tip: 常用come to a standstill，注意冠词a。

senses.en: Food such as hay or straw given to farm animals.
Material that can be used for a particular purpose.

ex.en: We stored extra fodder in the barn before winter.
ex.zh: 入冬前，我们在谷仓里储备了额外的饲料。

ex.en: Celebrity lifestyles often provide fodder for media coverage, diverting public attention from more significant social issues.
ex.zh: 名人的生活方式常成为媒体报道的素材，使公众忽略更重要的社会问题。

tip: 通常不可数；fodder for也可比喻供利用的素材。

senses.en: to make something operate or spread across the world

ex.en: Online shops help small businesses globalize without opening stores abroad.
ex.zh: 网店帮助小企业无需在海外开店就能走向全球。

ex.en: As companies globalize their operations, governments must cooperate to protect workers and maintain fair competition.
ex.zh: 随着企业将业务拓展至全球，各国政府必须合作保护劳动者并维护公平竞争。

tip: 英式英语也常拼作globalise。

senses.en: To move slowly from side to side, or cause this movement.
To influence someone's opinion, choice, or decision.
Power or influence over people or decisions.

ex.en: The branches swayed gently as we ate outside.
ex.zh: 我们在户外吃饭时，树枝轻轻摇曳。

ex.en: Emotional advertising can sway consumers' decisions even when competing products offer better value for money.
ex.zh: 即使竞争产品更划算，情感广告仍可能左右消费者的决定。

col: sway public opinion｜左右公众舆论
tip: sway既可指身体摇摆，也可指影响观点或决定。

senses.en: relating to space and the positions of objects within it

ex.en: Building with blocks helps children develop their spatial awareness.
ex.zh: 搭积木有助于孩子培养空间意识。

ex.en: Urban planners examine the spatial distribution of housing to ensure residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 城市规划者研究住房的空间分布，以确保居民能获得基本服务。

tip: spatial指空间关系；spacious指地方宽敞。

senses.en: done regularly or repeatedly as a habit

ex.en: His habitual lateness meant we often missed the bus.
ex.zh: 他习惯性迟到，害得我们常常错过公交车。

ex.en: Habitual use of private cars can increase urban congestion and discourage investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 习惯性使用私家车可能加剧城市拥堵，并削弱投资公共交通的动力。

tip: 形容反复发生的行为，也可修饰经常做某事的人。

senses.en: a sleep-inducing painkiller; also an illegal drug
causing sleep or reduced awareness

ex.en: The doctor prescribed a narcotic for severe pain after surgery.
ex.zh: 医生开了一种麻醉性镇痛药，用于缓解术后剧痛。

ex.en: Strict controls on narcotic medicines should prevent misuse without limiting access for patients with severe pain.
ex.zh: 对麻醉性药品的严格管控应防止滥用，同时不妨碍剧痛患者获得药物。

tip: 医学常指麻醉性镇痛药；法律语境可泛指毒品。

senses.en: The body's ability to resist disease; protection from something.

ex.en: Vaccination gives long-term immunity.
ex.zh: 接种疫苗带来长期免疫力。

senses.en: relating to the sky or space

ex.en: Stars and planets are celestial bodies.
ex.zh: 恒星和行星都是天体。

ex.en: Ancient sailors navigated by observing celestial objects such as the North Star.
ex.zh: 古代水手通过观察北极星等天体来导航。

tip: 与 terrestrial（地球的）相对。

senses.en: A secret plan by several people to do something wrong.

ex.en: Police uncovered a conspiracy to steal valuable paintings.
ex.zh: 警方发现了一起盗窃珍贵画作的阴谋。

ex.en: False conspiracy theories can spread rapidly online, weakening public trust in scientific institutions.
ex.zh: 虚假的阴谋论会在网上迅速传播，削弱公众对科研机构的信任。

col: conspiracy to commit fraud｜实施诈骗的共谋
tip: conspiracy to do sth指密谋做某事。

senses.en: The state of depending on or trusting someone or something.

ex.en: Cycling to work has reduced my reliance on buses.
ex.zh: 骑车上班减少了我对公交车的依赖。

ex.en: Reducing reliance on fossil fuels requires sustained investment in renewable energy and improvements to public transport infrastructure.
ex.zh: 减少对化石燃料的依赖，需要持续投资可再生能源，并改善公共交通基础设施。

col: heavy reliance on｜对……的严重依赖
reduce reliance on｜减少对……的依赖
tip: reliance是不可数名词，通常与on搭配。

senses.en: control over your feelings, behaviour, or desires
a rule or measure that limits actions or freedom
a device that prevents someone or something from moving freely

ex.en: She showed restraint and saved the last biscuit for me.
ex.zh: 她克制住自己，把最后一块饼干留给了我。

ex.en: Governments should exercise restraint when introducing restrictions that could limit citizens' access to reliable information.
ex.zh: 政府在引入可能限制公民获取可靠信息的规定时，应保持克制。

col: child restraint｜儿童安全约束装置
tip: 表自制通常不可数；表限制常用restraints on。

senses.en: a small bird known for singing while flying
something done for fun rather than for a serious purpose

ex.en: We heard a lark singing above the quiet fields.
ex.zh: 我们听见一只云雀在宁静的田野上空歌唱。

ex.en: Protecting grassland habitats benefits the lark and other birds threatened by increasingly intensive agricultural practices.
ex.zh: 保护草地栖息地有益于云雀及其他受到日益集约化农业活动威胁的鸟类。

tip: for a lark意为“为了好玩”，多用于英式口语。

senses.en: Having two parts, purposes, or aspects.

ex.en: This sofa has a dual purpose: sitting and sleeping.
ex.zh: 这张沙发有两种用途：坐着休息和睡觉。

ex.en: Many working parents face the dual challenge of earning an income and caring for young children.
ex.zh: 许多在职父母面临着挣钱和照顾幼儿的双重挑战。

tip: dual 强调两部分或双重功能；勿与 duel（决斗）混淆。

senses.en: A change made to a law, document, or proposal.

ex.en: We agreed on one small amendment to the contract.
ex.zh: 我们就合同的一处小修改达成了一致。

ex.en: The proposed amendment would require employers to provide safer working conditions for temporary staff.
ex.zh: 拟议的修正案将要求雇主为临时员工提供更安全的工作条件。

col: amendment to a law｜对法律的修订
tip: 表示对某文件的修改，用amendment to。

senses.en: the green substance in plants that absorbs light

ex.en: Chlorophyll makes leaves green.
ex.zh: 叶绿素使叶子呈绿色。

ex.en: Chlorophyll absorbs mainly red and blue light and reflects green, which is why most plants appear green to us.
ex.zh: 叶绿素主要吸收红光和蓝光、反射绿光，所以大多数植物看起来是绿色的。

tip: 与 photosynthesis、pigment 常一起出现。

senses.en: Relating to the breaking down of food in the body.

ex.en: The digestive system breaks food into nutrients.
ex.zh: 消化系统把食物分解成营养物质。

senses.en: To approach people and ask for their votes or support.
To ask people about their opinions on a particular issue.

ex.en: Volunteers canvassed the neighbourhood before the local election.
ex.zh: 志愿者在地方选举前到社区挨家挨户拉票。

ex.en: Local authorities should canvass residents' views before introducing major changes to public transport routes and schedules.
ex.zh: 地方政府在大幅调整公共交通路线和时刻表之前，应征求居民意见。

tip: canvass是拉票或征求意见；canvas指帆布。

senses.en: willing and happy to help other people

ex.en: An obliging neighbour watered our plants while we travelled.
ex.zh: 我们旅行时，一位热心的邻居帮我们浇了花。

ex.en: Obliging staff can improve patients' experiences by answering questions patiently and responding promptly to reasonable requests.
ex.zh: 乐于助人的工作人员可以通过耐心解答问题、及时回应合理要求来改善患者的体验。

col: an obliging neighbour｜乐于助人的邻居
tip: obliging 指乐于助人；obliged 常表示被迫或感激。

senses.en: A lack of ease or control in physical movement.
Discomfort or embarrassment in a social situation.

ex.en: His awkwardness on skates made every turn a challenge.
ex.zh: 他滑冰时动作笨拙，每次转弯都很吃力。

ex.en: Group activities can reduce the initial awkwardness students experience when interacting with classmates from different cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 小组活动可以减轻学生与不同文化背景的同学交流时最初的拘谨感。

tip: 通常不可数；可形容动作笨拙，也可表示社交尴尬。

senses.en: Noisy activity and confusion caused by excitement or disturbance

ex.en: A loose puppy caused a commotion in the café.
ex.zh: 一只没拴住的小狗在咖啡馆里引起了一阵骚动。

ex.en: The sudden commotion at the station highlighted the need for clearer procedures during unexpected service disruptions.
ex.zh: 车站突发的骚动凸显了在服务意外中断时制定更明确应对程序的必要性。

col: a sudden commotion｜突如其来的喧闹
tip: 常指短暂喧闹或混乱，不一定涉及暴力或暴乱。

senses.en: A woman who inherits or expects to inherit substantial wealth.

ex.en: The young heiress turned her family mansion into a museum.
ex.zh: 这位年轻的女继承人把家族宅邸改成了博物馆。

ex.en: The heiress funded scholarships for disadvantaged students, illustrating how inherited wealth can support wider educational opportunities.
ex.zh: 这位女继承人出资为弱势学生设立奖学金，展示了继承财富如何扩大教育机会。

col: heiress to a fortune｜巨额财产的女继承人
a wealthy heiress｜富有的女继承人
tip: h不发音；heir如今也可泛指任何性别的继承人。

senses.en: showing very strong and sincere feelings or beliefs

ex.en: She is a fervent supporter of our local football team.
ex.zh: 她是我们当地足球队的热情支持者。

ex.en: Fervent supporters of wildlife conservation argue that protecting natural habitats should take priority over commercial development.
ex.zh: 野生动物保护的热心支持者认为，保护自然栖息地应优先于商业开发。

col: a fervent supporter｜热情的支持者
a fervent believer｜坚定的信奉者
tip: 语气较正式，常修饰supporter、belief、hope。

senses.en: To spin or move around very quickly.
A spinning movement or a confusing rush of activity.

ex.en: Dry leaves whirled around us in the wind.
ex.zh: 干枯的树叶在风中绕着我们打转。

ex.en: As urban life accelerates, many workers become caught in a whirl of meetings and deadlines.
ex.zh: 随着城市生活节奏加快，许多上班族陷入接连不断的会议和截止期限之中。

col: a whirl of activity｜一连串忙乱的活动
tip: give it a whirl是口语，意为“试一试”。

senses.en: a structure in cells that carries genes

ex.en: Humans have 46 chromosomes.
ex.zh: 人类有46条染色体。

ex.en: During reproduction, each parent passes on half of its chromosomes, which is why offspring resemble both parents.
ex.zh: 繁殖时双亲各传递一半染色体，所以后代与父母双方都相像。

tip: gene（基因）位于 chromosome 上。

senses.en: made by combining different parts or materials
something made from several different parts or materials

ex.en: Our new garden bench is made from composite material.
ex.zh: 我们的新花园长椅是用复合材料制成的。

ex.en: Lightweight composite materials can reduce fuel consumption by making aircraft lighter without significantly compromising their strength.
ex.zh: 轻质复合材料能够减轻飞机重量，同时不明显损害其强度，从而降低燃料消耗。

tip: 强调由不同部分组合而成，常修饰material或image。

senses.en: Relating to the gradual development of species.

ex.en: Feathers may have had an evolutionary role in warmth.
ex.zh: 羽毛可能在保暖方面起过进化作用。

senses.en: All the plants naturally growing in a particular area.

ex.en: Our guide pointed out the island's unusual flora.
ex.zh: 导游向我们介绍了岛上不同寻常的植物。

ex.en: Protecting native flora helps maintain biodiversity and supports the insects that pollinate local crops.
ex.zh: 保护本土植物有助于维持生物多样性，并为给当地作物授粉的昆虫提供支持。

tip: flora指植物群；fauna指动物群。

senses.en: a hunting bird with sharp claws and a curved beak
someone who supports forceful policies, especially military action
to sell goods by offering them in public places

ex.en: A hawk circled slowly above the open field.
ex.zh: 一只鹰在空旷的田野上方缓缓盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting woodland habitats helps maintain hawk populations, which play an important role in controlling small mammals.
ex.zh: 保护林地栖息地有助于维持鹰的数量，而鹰在控制小型哺乳动物数量方面发挥着重要作用。

col: watch someone like a hawk｜紧盯某人
a foreign-policy hawk｜外交政策强硬派
tip: 鹰派hawk与主张和平的鸽派dove相对。

senses.en: A public statement of a group's beliefs, aims, and planned actions.

ex.en: Our club published a manifesto calling for cleaner parks.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部发表了一份宣言，呼吁让公园更清洁。

ex.en: The party's manifesto promises greater investment in public transport to reduce congestion in major cities.
ex.zh: 该党的政纲承诺加大公共交通投入，以缓解大城市的交通拥堵。

tip: 复数可用manifestos或manifestoes。

senses.en: A secure position for your feet on a surface.
The basis or status on which something operates.

ex.en: I lost my footing on the wet steps.
ex.zh: 我在湿滑的台阶上没站稳。

ex.en: Public funding can help place rural schools on an equal footing with their urban counterparts.
ex.zh: 公共资金能帮助农村学校获得与城市学校平等的地位。

col: on an equal footing｜处于平等地位
on a sound footing｜建立在稳固基础上
tip: on an equal footing表示地位平等。

senses.en: an optical illusion caused by light bending through unevenly heated air
something attractive that seems real or achievable but is not

ex.en: The distant pool was only a mirage in the desert.
ex.zh: 远处的水池只是沙漠中的蜃景。

ex.en: For many young workers, affordable home ownership remains a mirage as property prices rise faster than wages.
ex.zh: 对许多年轻劳动者而言，由于房价涨幅超过工资涨幅，买得起住房仍是可望而不可即的梦想。

col: a mirage of prosperity｜繁荣的幻象
tip: 指光学蜃景或虚幻希望，不表示普通雾气。

senses.en: the distance around a circle

ex.en: Measure the circumference of the tree trunk.
ex.zh: 量一下树干的周长。

ex.en: More than two thousand years ago, a Greek scholar estimated the earth's circumference using shadows in two cities.
ex.zh: 两千多年前，一位希腊学者利用两座城市的影子估算出地球周长。

col: the circumference of the earth｜地球周长
tip: circum-（环绕）+ ference（带）。

senses.en: sound with frequencies too high for humans to hear
a medical examination using sound waves to show internal organs

ex.en: The doctor used ultrasound to examine my shoulder.
ex.zh: 医生用超声波检查了我的肩膀。

ex.en: Ultrasound allows doctors to examine internal organs without exposing patients to the radiation used in conventional X-rays.
ex.zh: 超声检查让医生能够观察内脏，而不使患者接触常规X光检查所用的辐射。

tip: 指超声波时不可数；指一次检查可说an ultrasound。

senses.en: an introduction that helps people adjust to a new setting
the direction in which something faces or is positioned
a person's or organisation's basic interests, beliefs, or preferences

ex.en: During orientation, a student guide showed us the library.
ex.zh: 入学指导期间，一位学生向导带我们参观了图书馆。

ex.en: A comprehensive orientation programme can help international students understand academic expectations and access essential support services.
ex.zh: 全面的入学指导计划能帮助国际学生了解学业要求，并获得必要的支持服务。

col: orientation programme｜入学或入职指导计划
tip: 入学指导常用orientation；方位义常用于建筑。

senses.en: The study of genes and how traits are passed on.

ex.en: Mendel is called the father of genetics.
ex.zh: 孟德尔被称为遗传学之父。

senses.en: an animal that eats other animals

ex.en: A tiger is a carnivore with powerful jaws.
ex.zh: 老虎是一种颌部强有力的食肉动物。

ex.en: Protecting large carnivores can help maintain balanced ecosystems by preventing excessive growth in prey populations.
ex.zh: 保护大型食肉动物有助于防止猎物种群过度增长，从而维持生态系统平衡。

tip: carnivore是名词；carnivorous是形容词。

senses.en: An area of land that lies high above sea level.
Relating to land high above sea level.

ex.en: We explored the highlands on foot during our holiday.
ex.zh: 假期里，我们徒步探索了高地地区。

ex.en: Highland communities often face transport difficulties because steep terrain makes road construction expensive and challenging.
ex.zh: 高地社区经常面临交通困难，因为陡峭的地形使道路建设成本高昂且困难重重。

tip: 名词常用复数highlands；单数常作形容词。

senses.en: An achievement requiring great skill, strength, or courage.

ex.en: Carrying that huge sofa upstairs was quite a feat.
ex.zh: 把那张大沙发搬上楼可真不容易。

ex.en: Building a railway across mountainous terrain remains an impressive feat of engineering, even with modern technology.
ex.zh: 即使有现代技术，在山区修建铁路仍是一项令人赞叹的工程壮举。

col: an impressive feat｜令人赞叹的壮举
a feat of engineering｜工程壮举
no mean feat｜了不起的成就
tip: 与feet同音；no mean feat意为很了不起。

senses.en: someone responsible for supervising or protecting a place
the person in charge of a prison, especially in America

ex.en: The park warden helped us find the campsite.
ex.zh: 公园管理员帮我们找到了露营地。

ex.en: A wildlife warden can help protect endangered species by monitoring habitats and guiding visitors away from sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 野生动物保护区管理员可以通过监测栖息地、引导游客远离生态敏感区来帮助保护濒危物种。

tip: 美式prison warden指监狱长，不是普通狱警。

senses.en: To state firmly that something is true.
To firmly exercise or defend a right, power, or position.

ex.en: He asserted that he had already paid for lunch.
ex.zh: 他坚称自己已经付过午餐钱了。

ex.en: Some educators assert that regular feedback improves student motivation more effectively than frequent formal examinations.
ex.zh: 一些教育工作者坚称，定期反馈比频繁的正式考试更能有效提高学生的学习积极性。

col: assert your rights｜维护自己的权利
assert yourself｜坚定表达自己的立场
tip: assert强调坚定表态，不代表已经提供证据。

senses.en: to exist together at the same time or place

ex.en: Cats and dogs can coexist peacefully.
ex.zh: 猫和狗可以和平共处。

ex.en: Two bird species can coexist on the same tree if they feed on insects in different parts of it.
ex.zh: 如果两种鸟在同一棵树的不同部位捕食昆虫，它们就能共存。

tip: 生态学中与 niche（生态位）一起出现。

senses.en: Forced absence from one's own country, often for political reasons
A person forced to live away from their own country
To force someone to leave their own country

ex.en: After years in exile, she finally returned home.
ex.zh: 流亡多年后，她终于回到了家乡。

ex.en: Many writers living in exile use literature to preserve cultural traditions and describe their experiences of displacement.
ex.zh: 许多流亡作家通过文学保存文化传统，并讲述他们流离失所的经历。

col: force someone into exile｜迫使某人流亡
tip: in exile表示处于流亡状态，通常不加冠词。

senses.en: a meeting where experts discuss a particular subject

ex.en: Leila met several researchers at a symposium yesterday.
ex.zh: 莱拉昨天在一场专题研讨会上结识了几位研究人员。

ex.en: The international symposium brought together scientists to discuss practical solutions to urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 这场国际专题研讨会汇聚了科学家，共同讨论解决城市空气污染的可行办法。

col: attend a symposium｜参加专题研讨会
a symposium on climate change｜气候变化专题研讨会
host a symposium｜主办专题研讨会
tip: 复数可用symposia或symposiums。

senses.en: Doubtful that a claim or idea is true or useful.

ex.en: I'm sceptical about this cream's promise of instant results.
ex.zh: 我对这款面霜宣称的即时效果持怀疑态度。

ex.en: Many consumers remain sceptical about environmental claims made by companies that provide little evidence of sustainable practices.
ex.zh: 许多消费者仍对企业的环保宣传持怀疑态度，因为这些企业几乎未提供可持续实践的证据。

col: sceptical of claims｜怀疑某些说法
tip: 英式拼写sceptical，美式通常写skeptical。

senses.en: The passing of traits from parents to offspring; money or property received after someone dies.

ex.en: Mendel studied the inheritance of pea color.
ex.zh: 孟德尔研究了豌豆颜色的遗传。

senses.en: to become involved in a situation to influence what happens
to interrupt a conversation with a comment
to happen between events, sometimes preventing a planned action

ex.en: The coach intervened before the argument became more heated.
ex.zh: 教练在争论进一步升级之前进行了调解。

ex.en: Governments may need to intervene when market competition fails to provide affordable essential services.
ex.zh: 当市场竞争无法提供价格可承受的基本服务时，政府可能需要干预。

col: intervene in a dispute｜介入纠纷
tip: 不及物动词：intervene in sth；不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: The process of checking that something is true or accurate.

ex.en: The website requires identity verification before I can withdraw money.
ex.zh: 这个网站要求先验证身份，我才能提现。

ex.en: Independent verification of research findings is essential for maintaining public confidence in scientific advice.
ex.zh: 对研究结果进行独立验证，对于维持公众对科学建议的信任至关重要。

tip: 常用verification of，表示对身份、事实或结果的核实。

senses.en: listening or watching carefully
taking care to notice and meet someone's needs

ex.en: The children were attentive as their grandmother explained the game.
ex.zh: 祖母讲解游戏规则时，孩子们听得很专心。

ex.en: Teachers who are attentive to individual learning needs can help students participate more confidently in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 关注个体学习需求的教师能帮助学生更自信地参与课堂讨论。

tip: attentive to后接关注的对象；也可形容服务周到。

senses.en: the mental process of knowing and understanding

ex.en: Sleep is important for cognition.
ex.zh: 睡眠对认知很重要。

ex.en: Studies of crows reveal surprisingly advanced cognition, including the ability to use tools to reach food.
ex.zh: 对乌鸦的研究揭示了惊人的高级认知能力，包括用工具取食。

tip: 形容词 cognitive 已收录。

senses.en: The speed at which music is played.
The pace at which an activity or process happens.

ex.en: The drummer increased the tempo, and everyone danced faster.
ex.zh: 鼓手加快了节奏，大家也跳得更快了。

ex.en: The tempo of urban life has accelerated as digital services make daily tasks increasingly immediate.
ex.zh: 随着数字服务让日常事务的处理越来越即时，城市生活节奏也加快了。

col: the tempo of life｜生活节奏
tip: 指音乐的快慢，不等于表示节奏型的rhythm。

senses.en: the state of being equal in value, meaning, or function

ex.en: The balanced scales showed the equivalence of the two weights.
ex.zh: 天平保持平衡，表明两边的重量相等。

ex.en: Establishing equivalence between qualifications from different countries can make it easier for skilled workers to find employment abroad.
ex.zh: 确立不同国家学历资格之间的等同性，可以帮助技术人才更容易地在国外就业。

tip: 常用equivalence between A and B表示两者等同。

senses.en: Either of the two openings at the bottom of the nose.

ex.en: One nostril felt blocked when I woke this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上醒来时，我觉得一侧鼻孔堵住了。

ex.en: Air entering through each nostril is warmed and filtered before it reaches the lungs.
ex.zh: 从每个鼻孔进入的空气在到达肺部前都会被加温和过滤。

tip: 可数名词；指两个鼻孔时用复数nostrils。

senses.en: a legal right to control an invention's production and sale
to obtain legal protection for an invention
very clear and easy to recognize

ex.en: Her uncle holds a patent for a folding bicycle.
ex.zh: 她叔叔拥有一项折叠自行车专利。

ex.en: Patent protection can encourage innovation by allowing inventors to recover the costs of developing new technologies.
ex.zh: 专利保护能让发明者收回新技术的研发成本，从而鼓励创新。

col: apply for a patent｜申请专利
patent an invention｜为发明取得专利
tip: 专利是patent；版权是copyright，二者不同。

senses.en: The use of living things to make products or solve problems.

ex.en: Biotechnology produced new vaccines.
ex.zh: 生物技术生产出了新疫苗。

senses.en: The crime of betraying your country, especially by helping its enemies.

ex.en: The museum guide explained why the official faced treason charges.
ex.zh: 博物馆讲解员解释了那位官员为何受到叛国罪指控。

ex.en: Historical trials for treason reveal how governments have defined loyalty and responded to perceived threats.
ex.zh: 历史上的叛国罪审判揭示了政府如何界定忠诚，以及如何应对其认定的威胁。

tip: 通常不可数，指严重的背叛国家行为。

senses.en: A pupil who stays away from school without permission
Absent from school without permission

ex.en: The teacher found two truants hiding behind the playground.
ex.zh: 老师发现两个逃学的学生躲在操场后面。

ex.en: Schools should support persistent truants by addressing bullying and family difficulties rather than relying solely on punishment.
ex.zh: 学校应通过解决欺凌和家庭困难来帮助经常逃学的学生，而不是只依靠惩罚。

tip: 英式英语play truant意为逃学，不是普通的请假缺课。

senses.en: A deep, wide opening in rock or the ground.
A major difference separating people, ideas, or situations.

ex.en: We crossed the deep chasm on a narrow bridge.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一座窄桥跨过了深深的峡谷。

ex.en: Unequal access to digital technology has widened the chasm between wealthy and disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 获取数字技术的机会不平等，扩大了富裕社区与弱势社区之间的差距。

col: a widening chasm｜不断扩大的鸿沟
bridge the chasm｜弥合巨大差距
tip: ch读/k/；比喻巨大差距时常用chasm between。

senses.en: to settle in and take control of an area

ex.en: European powers colonized many parts of Africa.
ex.zh: 欧洲列强殖民了非洲许多地区。

ex.en: After the volcanic eruption, mosses and lichens were the first organisms to colonize the bare rock.
ex.zh: 火山喷发后，苔藓和地衣是最先在裸露岩石上定居的生物。

tip: 生态学中指物种首次进入新区域。

senses.en: Unwillingness or hesitation to do something.

ex.en: With obvious reluctance, Leo handed his favourite toy back.
ex.zh: 利奥明显很不情愿地把心爱的玩具还了回去。

ex.en: Some commuters show reluctance to use public transport because services are infrequent and unreliable.
ex.zh: 一些通勤者不愿乘坐公共交通，因为班次稀少且不可靠。

col: overcome one's reluctance｜克服不情愿的心理
tip: 通常不可数，常接to do，表示不愿做某事。

senses.en: Lasting anger towards someone because of an earlier wrong
To feel unwilling to give or allow something

ex.en: She still holds a grudge over the broken vase.
ex.zh: 她仍因花瓶被打碎的事心怀怨恨。

ex.en: Unresolved workplace conflicts can lead employees to hold grudges, reducing cooperation and damaging team morale.
ex.zh: 未解决的职场冲突可能导致员工心怀积怨，削弱合作并损害团队士气。

col: bear a grudge against someone｜对某人怀恨在心
tip: hold a grudge against sb表示对某人怀恨在心。

senses.en: relating to an empire or its ruler
using measurement units such as inches, pounds, and gallons

ex.en: We admired the golden roof of the imperial palace.
ex.zh: 我们赞叹那座皇宫的金色屋顶。

ex.en: Former imperial capitals often preserve architectural features that reflect their historical wealth and political influence.
ex.zh: 昔日的帝国首都往往保留着体现其历史财富和政治影响力的建筑特色。

tip: imperial units指英制单位，与metric units相对。

senses.zh: 枝叶繁茂的；绿树成荫的
senses.en: Having many leaves or many trees with abundant leaves.
Having leaves as the main edible part of a vegetable.

ex.en: We ate our sandwiches beneath a large leafy tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵枝叶繁茂的大树下吃了三明治。

ex.en: Leafy neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing by providing shade, reducing heat, and encouraging outdoor activity.
ex.zh: 绿树成荫的社区能提供遮阴、降低气温并鼓励户外活动，从而改善居民的身心健康。

tip: leafy streets指绿树成荫的街道，不是落叶满地。

senses.en: The state of being economically successful and financially secure.

ex.en: The busy harbour brought prosperity to our town.
ex.zh: 繁忙的港口为我们的小镇带来了繁荣。

ex.en: Investment in education can support long-term prosperity by giving workers the skills needed in a changing economy.
ex.zh: 教育投资能让劳动者掌握经济转型所需的技能，从而促进长期繁荣。

tip: 不可数名词；形容词用prosperous。

senses.en: Animals eating grass in a field.

ex.en: The land is used for sheep grazing.
ex.zh: 这片土地用于放羊。

senses.en: Made of or containing metal.

senses.zh: 有金属光泽、声音或味道的
senses.en: Resembling metal in appearance, sound, or taste.

ex.en: The metallic frame makes this chair surprisingly heavy.
ex.zh: 金属框架让这把椅子出乎意料地重。

ex.en: Metallic components can often be recovered from discarded electronics, reducing the need to extract new raw materials.
ex.zh: 废弃电子产品中的金属部件通常可以回收，从而减少开采新原材料的需求。

col: a metallic sound｜金属般的声音
a metallic finish｜金属光泽饰面
tip: metallic既可指含金属，也可形容像金属的光泽或声音。

senses.en: a product that can be bought and sold

ex.en: Oil is a valuable commodity.
ex.zh: 石油是有价值的商品。

ex.en: Salt was once such a precious commodity that soldiers were sometimes paid with it.
ex.zh: 盐曾经是极珍贵的商品，士兵有时以盐作为报酬。

tip: 常指原材料类商品。

senses.en: Very generous, elaborate, or expensive
To give something generously or in large quantities

ex.en: They prepared a lavish feast for the whole family.
ex.zh: 他们为全家准备了一顿丰盛的大餐。

ex.en: Critics argue that lavish spending on official ceremonies diverts public funds from essential services such as healthcare.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，在官方仪式上大肆花费会挤占医疗等基本服务的公共资金。

col: a lavish lifestyle｜奢华的生活方式
lavish praise on someone｜大加赞扬某人
lavish attention on someone｜给予某人大量关注
tip: 动词常用lavish sth on sb，表示大量给予。

senses.en: Able to do many things or serve many different purposes.

ex.en: This versatile pan works well for soups and stir-fries.
ex.zh: 这个多用途锅做汤、炒菜都很好用。

ex.en: Employers increasingly value versatile graduates who can adapt to different roles and learn new skills.
ex.zh: 雇主越来越重视能适应不同岗位并学习新技能的多面手毕业生。

col: a versatile performer｜多才多艺的表演者
tip: 既可形容人多才多艺，也可形容物用途广泛。

senses.en: To stop sleeping, or cause someone to stop sleeping.
To cause a feeling, interest, or awareness to develop.

ex.en: Birdsong awakened me just as sunlight reached the curtains.
ex.zh: 阳光刚照到窗帘，鸟鸣声就把我唤醒了。

ex.en: Visits to science museums can awaken children's curiosity and encourage them to explore unfamiliar subjects.
ex.zh: 参观科学博物馆可以激发孩子们的好奇心，鼓励他们探索陌生的学科。

col: awaken from sleep｜从睡梦中醒来
awaken to the dangers｜意识到危险
tip: awaken是动词；表示“醒着的”用awake。

senses.en: loss of the ability to move part or all of the body
a state in which action or progress becomes impossible

ex.en: The injury caused temporary paralysis in his left leg.
ex.zh: 这次受伤导致他的左腿暂时瘫痪。

ex.en: Political disagreements can lead to administrative paralysis, delaying essential decisions on housing and public transport.
ex.zh: 政治分歧可能导致行政停滞，延误有关住房和公共交通的重要决策。

tip: 既指身体瘫痪，也可比喻机构或决策陷入停滞。
